labels.reason: Source-backed candidate coverage consists of reported rat PK parameters, study body-weight summaries, dosing and sampling context, and urinary/GI recovery summaries. Voriconazole is the test drug; tofacitinib is co-administered only in the With TFC conditions. Plasma assay is HPLC with fluorescence detection. No concentration-time observations are supplied: the note places curves in Fig. 3 only, not digitized. Parameter SDs do not establish individual PK variability. Single IV and oral regimens use different doses and do not establish dose dependence or time-dependent clearance. Requirement links indicate partial input coverage, not model or translation qualification. The columns contain heterogeneous row-specific units, recorded in the parameter labels; no common column unit is stated. Missing cells have no supplied interpretation. Counts, Vss significance reporting and the F definition require review.

evidence.quote: Pharmacokinetic parameters after single IV and oral voriconazole, with and without tofacitinib
S08 | DOI 10.3390/pharmaceutics13050740 | Table 2 (Lee et al. 2021; read from the PDF)

Male Sprague-Dawley rats, about 7 weeks, 230-240 g at purchase (table gives body weight at study). IV 10 mg/kg over 1 min via the jugular vein (4 mL/kg; 0.9% NaCl containing 50% PEG 400); oral 20 mg/kg by gastric gavage (6 mL/kg). Carotid-artery plasma; HPLC with fluorescence detection; LLOQ not stated in the text read.

IV sampling 0, 1, 5, 15, 30, 60, 120, 180, 240, 360, 480, 600 and/or 720 min; oral 0-960 min. Urine 0-24 h and whole GI tract at 24 h. Concentration curves are in Fig. 3 only (not digitized). "Values are means ± standard deviation (SD)."

"With TFC" columns are a drug-interaction condition (tofacitinib 10 mg/kg IV or 20 mg/kg oral given together), not voriconazole alone. IV with-TFC n is 6 in the methods and 5 in the table. Footnote: "* Significantly different from respective control group (p < 0.05)."
Text: Vss with tofacitinib "significantly greater (127%)", but the table shows no asterisk on Vss. F is AUC oral / AUC IV per the methods; printed values 106 and 122.

findings.reason: F0003:S2:T1 provides source-linked reported parameter summaries, study weights, assay, dosing and sampling context. Individual records, detection limits, AUC integration limits, detailed parameter-estimation definitions and explanations for unpopulated cells were not located on this page. The note explicitly states that LLOQ was not stated in the text read.
findings.needed_material: During authorized preparation, retain the summaries at their reported level and obtain source-backed parameter definitions, missing-cell explanations and assay limits where available; preserve remaining unknowns without inventing values.

findings.reason: Single IV and oral routes, plasma assay and tofacitinib conditions are available. Total versus unbound basis, salt/free-base dose basis, health/infection and immune state, meningitis status, grapefruit-juice exposure, actual versus nominal times and precise sampling-time origin are NOT_FOUND. No day-2 or escalating-regimen identity is established.
findings.needed_material: Preserve route and co-medication groups separately. Seek authorized source clarification for consequential unknowns and record any later conversion justification; do not assign unstated treatment contexts.

findings.reason: A5 reports IV with-TFC n as 6 in the methods and 5 in the table; C7 states n = 5. Both counts are retained and neither is adopted as a resolved count.
findings.needed_material: Human review of the source count discrepancy and a recorded decision before using the affected count for interpretation or uncertainty assessment.

findings.reason: A6 reports Vss with tofacitinib as significantly greater (127%) while noting no table asterisk on Vss. B17 and C17 contain the reported Vss summaries without a significance marker. The text statement and table annotation difference remain unresolved.
findings.needed_material: Human review of the original Vss statement, comparison definition and table annotation; retain the reported values and text without adding an asterisk or recomputing the percentage.

findings.reason: A6 defines F as AUC oral / AUC IV and repeats printed values 106 and 122, matching D20 and E20. A3 states different IV and oral doses. Dose normalization and the precise interpretation of these F values are not established by the supplied definition.
findings.needed_material: Source-backed clarification of the F calculation and dose normalization before using these values as bioavailability inputs. Preserve the printed values without recalculation.
